mentions.name: Meal planning agent-to-script automation
mentions.description: A personal meal-planning setup in which a weekly ChatGPT agent task suggested dinner options based on nutritional constraints and generated shopping lists; after several iterations it matured into a simple script that generates meal combinations from a fixed set of recipes and their ingredients.
mentions.source_excerpt: Meal planning: I had a weekly ChatGPT task that suggested dinner options based on nutritional constraints and generated a shopping list (e.g. two dinners with 100g of chicken -> buy 200g). After a few iterations, it became clear that with a fixed set of recipes and their ingredients, a simple script generating combinations was enough. The agent's reasoning had already done its job — it helped me understand the problem well enough to replace itself.
